prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Astatine (At) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a photographic darkroom under red safelight, trays of solution on a wet bench and prints clipped to a line overhead
Light direction: a low warm light source near her — a lamp, a fire or a screen — glowing on her from below shoulder height.
Outfit: a fitted off-shoulder bodycon dress hugging the bust, waist and hips, ending above the knee — in muted olive green; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; head tilted slightly; camera slightly above, looking down at her.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right fingertips rest lightly on her cheek.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: slightly drawn brow, narrowed steady eyes, mouth firmly closed.

Framing: a close-up — her face and hair fill most of the frame and the bottom edge crosses at her collarbones; nothing below the shoulders shows, and her hands and anything she holds stay below the frame unless raised to her face.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — astatine: the rarest naturally occurring element, less than a gram of it spread through the whole of the Earth's crust at any moment, named from the Greek for unstable; first made in 1940 by firing alpha particles at bismuth in a cyclotron after years of false claims, and found in nature in 1943 in the decay chains of uranium and thorium; even its longest-lived form lasts only hours, and any visible speck would boil away in its own heat, so no one has ever seen a piece of it, only guessed it would be a dark, metallic-looking solid; the heaviest halogen, it seeks the thyroid like iodine and, living about seven hours, is being shaped into an alpha-ray medicine that strikes only cancer cells — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: lean and toned — a slim, firm waist with softly defined vertical abs and lightly sculpted arms and shoulders, a full bust — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
